name: Echo Lattice — Field Ledger
notes: Single source of truth for Echo Lattice's palette. Human-referenced, deliberately anti-neon. If you feel the urge to add mystical purple, cyberpunk cyan, or a rainbow gradient, delete it and re-read 05_ART_BIBLE.md.

paper_bone.role: base surface — printer-warm cream, never pure white

ink_black.role: walls, glyphs, type — deep sepia black, never pure #000

rust_fossil.role: fossilized paths / hardened habit walls — iron oxide

rust_deep.role: old rust seams, joins between fossilized tiles

slate_teal.role: cold accent for signage, keys, doors — NOT purple

cadmium_warn.role: rewrite-imminent flash — used sparingly, one heartbeat

copper_key.role: keys, doors, tactile interactables — dry-plate etch

banlist.notes: These are visually banned in-source unless the design lead approves an exception in writing.
colors: neon violet, neon cyan, cyberpunk pink
effects: fantasy runes, arcane sigils, glowing eldritch dust

typography.display: Geometric grotesk, tightly tracked (e.g. Akkurat, Inter Tight, or IBM Plex Sans Condensed).
typography.body: Newsprint serif for flavor text and printed-ledger UI (e.g. IBM Plex Serif or PT Serif).
typography.mono: Monospaced grotesk for seed strings and the move buffer punch-card (e.g. IBM Plex Mono).
typography.case: Small caps for headers. Sentence case in body. NEVER ALL CAPS SCREAMING except on the title lockup.
typography.line_quality: 1px sepia ink at 32px reference tile. Never anti-alias to pure black.

tile_grid.diagonal_walls: MVP: no diagonals. 1.0: unlockable via 'bevel' transform pack.
